subject: executor: introduce `AggFuncUpdateContext` and `AggFuncBuildContext` to evaluate and build aggeration functions (#51224)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent, focusing on executor aggregation code paths. The change is primarily a context-interface refactor: `AggFunc` build/update methods now take `expression/context` `BuildContext`/`EvalContext` via new aliases (`AggFuncBuildContext`, `AggFuncUpdateContext`), with mechanical signature updates across agg funcs (incl. sliding window). `HashAgg` workers drop an unused stored session ctx field. The only non-trivial behavior-touching change spotted is `GROUP_CONCAT` truncation handling routing warnings/errors via `StmtCtx.TypeCtx()` (equivalent flag/warning sink to prior `StmtCtx.TypeFlags()`/`StmtCtx.AppendWarning`). No Blocker/High correctness/semantics/concurrency/session behavior issues found, and later history up to `upstream/master` does not show a follow-up fix indicating a regression attributable to this commit.
